name: Five Star Program
summary: Annual grants for community partnerships in the United States that combine on-the-ground habitat restoration, such as wetland, riparian, coastal or urban tree canopy work, with local outreach, education and stewardship.
reporting: Grantees report on project metrics they choose from the programme's list in NFWF's Easygrants system, such as acres restored, trees planted and people reached.

status.quote: Five Star Grant Program 2026 Request for Proposals - CLOSED

deadline.quote: Full Proposal Due Date June 4, 2026, by 11:59 PM EST

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include non-profit 501(c) organizations, state government agencies, local governments, municipal governments, Tribal Governments and Organizations and educational institutions

geography.quote: providing measurable and meaningful conservation and educational outcomes in communities across the United States

access.quote: All application materials must be submitted online through National Fish and Wildlife Foundation's Easygrants system.

window.quote: NFWF anticipates one round of full proposals annually for this program.

amount.quote: Awards range from $30,000 to $150,000 with 30-40 grants awarded per year.

co_finance_required.quote: Projects are required to meet or exceed a 1:0.75 match ratio to be competitive

reporting.quote: the Five Star program has a list of metrics in Easygrants for full proposal applicants to choose from for future reporting
